backup.addr.changed: Devices connect to {old}, but this server is {here}: after the move, reissue their settings (menu 17 → devices or the panel’s “Users”). To avoid this on future moves, give the gateway a domain (menu 17 → Client address) and issue settings with it.
backup.addr.domain: Devices connect via the domain {old}: point its A record to {here} — and the issued settings will work without new ones.
backup.addr.unknown: Couldn’t detect this server’s public address: after the move, check the client address (menu 17 → Client address) — the backup has {old}.
backup.ch.bot: this server’s bot will be replaced by the one from the backup
backup.ch.gateway_off: the gateway will turn off — it’s off in the backup
backup.err.awg_export: This is an AmneziaWG export, not a Settings backup: load it in “Protocols → AmneziaWG engine → Import”.
backup.err.damaged: The backup file is damaged (checksum mismatch) — download or copy it again.
backup.err.foreign_file: The backup contains an unknown file ({rel}) — not loading it.
backup.err.format: The backup has format {v} — update Kaskad here and try again.
backup.err.forwards_need_nft: Forwards can be moved only to the nftables engine (menu 16 → 1).
backup.err.gateway_need_nft: The gateway can be moved only to the nftables engine (menu 16 → 1).
backup.err.newer: The backup was made by a newer Kaskad ({version}) — update Kaskad here (menu 11) and try again.
backup.err.no_openssl: openssl is missing — install the openssl package (apt install openssl).
backup.err.no_undo: Nothing to undo: no settings backup has been loaded on this server yet.
backup.err.not_a_copy: This is not a Kaskad backup file (one is made by “Download backup” in the panel or menu 16).
backup.err.password_line: The backup password must be a single line.
backup.err.password_short: The backup password must be at least {n} characters.
backup.err.pool_busy: The key pool keeps changing (another window) — run the move again.
backup.err.shape: the copy holds data of an unexpected shape ({kind}) — the file is damaged or was not made by Kaskad
backup.err.snapshot_failed: Couldn’t back up the current settings ({error}) — nothing was changed.
backup.err.too_big: The file is larger than {mb} MB — it’s not a Kaskad backup.
backup.err.truncated: The backup file is truncated — copy or download the whole file.
backup.log.cert_back: the certificate of the domain {domain} handed out again (until {until}) — the one on disk
backup.log.use_back: {title} is on the certificate of the domain {domain} again — as before the import
backup.log.tariff_dropped: the plan from the copy was not restored: the copy is from another server, the plan has no server mark, or this server has no machine-id
backup.note.tariff_dropped: The plan from the copy was not restored: it could not be confirmed that the copy was made on this server. Enter this server’s plan again.
backup.preview.vless_consent: VLESS: the consent to Reality in the copy was given for another domain ({domain}) — it won’t be taken; after the move VLESS chooses TLS with its own domain when it can (with devices — a recommendation with the price)
backup.preview.tariff_dropped: The plan from the copy will not be restored: it could not be confirmed that the copy was made on this server. After the import, enter this server’s plan again.
backup.log.returned_none: nothing, everything already matches the snapshot
backup.n.agent_keys: {n} AI agent key|{n} AI agent keys
backup.note.bot_restarted: the bot restarted with the moved token
backup.note.bot_start: bot: the token is moved — start the bot in menu 8
backup.note.cert: domain {domain}: once its A record points to this server, issue a certificate (menu 19 or “Domain and site” in the panel){site}
backup.note.cert_site: ; the masking site is turned on there too
backup.note.cert_back: domain {domain}: its certificate is no longer on this server or has expired — issue a certificate (menu 19 or “Domain and site” in the panel){site}
backup.note.use_back: {title} worked on the certificate of the domain {domain} before the import — turn it on again once the certificate is here (menu 19 or “Domain and site” in the panel)
backup.note.mcp_cut: agent keys removed: {n}, those agents’ connections closed
backup.note.mcp_cut_all: agent keys removed: {n}; other agents may have disconnected too — it wasn’t clear which connection is whose. If an agent stops answering, restart its app
backup.note.panel_public: open access to the panel was on (port {port}) — turn it on here: menu 18
backup.note.site_mode: domain {domain}: the masking site was on — turn it on here: menu 19 → 6 or “Domain and site” in the panel
backup.note.vless_tls: On the old server VLESS ran in TLS mode on the domain {domain}; here it’s on Reality for now (TLS needs the server’s own site). Once you issue the certificate and turn on the site, VLESS switches to TLS by itself, and the VLESS links must be reissued.
backup.note.vless_tls_back: Before the import VLESS ran in TLS mode on the domain {domain}; now it’s on Reality. Once the domain has its certificate and the site is on (menu 19 → 6 or “Domain and site” in the panel), VLESS goes back to TLS and the previous VLESS links connect again.
backup.preview.bot_token: One bot token — one server: after the move, stop the bot on the old server (menu 8), otherwise Telegram will deliver messages to one or the other at random.
backup.preview.mcp_on: The AI agent keys of the copy ({n}) will be added: an agent with such a key runs this server over SSH — every action, exporting a copy and updating included. Bring them only from your own copy.
backup.preview.need_nft: The gateway and forwards can be moved only to the nftables engine, and this server uses iptables: menu 16 → 1 (“Switch to nftables”), then try again.
backup.rollback.failed: Couldn’t fully restore the previous settings ({error}): their backup is {snap}; “Undo” — the panel’s “Settings” or menu 16 → 6 → 3.
backup.row.github_keep: ; this server has its own — it stays
backup.row.github_none: no GitHub key in the backup
backup.row.mcp: agent keys {keys} (added to the ones here: {here})
backup.row.mcp_off: agent keys {keys} — not brought over: an agent with such a key runs the server. To bring them, tick it separately, and only from your own copy
backup.row.panel: ask for password: {ask}; the panel password isn’t moved
backup.row.site: domain {domain}{instead}; the certificate is issued anew once the domain points to this server
backup.say.gateway_purge: Removing the gateway the move installed…
backup.text.returned_none: Nothing to restore — everything already matches the snapshot.
backup.text.saved: Previous settings saved: {snap}. To bring them back — “Undo” (the panel’s “Settings” or menu 16 → 6 → 3).
backup.title.exits: exits: the key pool and subscriptions
backup.title.gateway: gateway: users, devices, protocols with their keys, routes, routing rules
backup.warn.cert_back: the certificate of the domain {domain} was not handed out again: {error}
backup.warn.forward_ssh: forward {proto}/{port} not moved: SSH uses this port here — {why}
backup.warn.monitor_bad: monitor file {name} not moved: it is not a monitor file (an address, an interval and a threshold are needed)
backup.warn.gateway_files: the time zone or the traffic counters of the copy were not written: {error} — the rest is restored
backup.warn.moved: protocol settings changed ({changes}) — reissue settings to the devices of these protocols
backup.warn.site_back: the site on the domain {domain} did not come back on: {error}
backup.warn.use_back: {title} did not go back to the certificate of the domain {domain}: {error}
backup.warn.panel_reload: the panel didn’t reload its settings: {error}
backup.note.vless_consent: VLESS: the consent to Reality in the copy was given for another domain ({domain}) — not taken; the server switches to TLS when it can (with devices — a recommendation with the price)
